blocks.text: A most accurate description of this bird, which the Arabs call Rachaeme, was given by Hasselquist in his Travels, p. 286–289 of the German trans.; he gave it the name Vultur percnopterus, capite nudo, gula plumulosa [with naked head, downy throat], and under this name it also appears in the System. Linn. vol. 1, part 1, p. 249.
